block.name: Function
block.longDescription: This is a core workflow block. Execute custom JavaScript or Python code within your workflow. JavaScript without imports runs locally for fast execution, while code with imports or Python uses E2B sandbox.
block.bestPractices:
- Environment variables can be accessed using the {{VAR_NAME}} syntax.
- You can reference parameters from other blocks using the <paramName> syntax.
- JavaScript code without imports executes locally for optimal performance.
- If your code requires imports or you're using Python, execution happens in an E2B sandbox.
- The function body should return a value that will be available as the block's output.

code.description: JavaScript or Python code to execute

result.description: Return value from the executed JavaScript function

stdout.description: Console log output and debug messages from function execution
